scope.production_network: Every Rust production TCP/UDP allocation, availability probe, bind, provider bind request, pre-bound listener consumer, and inherited socket found by the recorded scans.
scope.local_ipc: Production Unix-domain binds and inherited descriptors are classified separately because a host TCP/UDP PortLease must not absorb filesystem-path ownership.
scope.tests: Inline and path-owned test/bench fixtures are non-production exemptions only when their enclosing cfg/module or target is recorded below.

scan_commands: rg -n 'PublishedEndpointProtocol|PublishedEndpoint' crates/nimbus-sandbox crates/nimbus-services crates/nimbus-tenant crates/nimbus-system crates/nimbus-machine crates/nimbus-node crates/nimbus-server crates/nimbus-cli

portable_owner_sites.disposition: Cidr remains core; portable segment identity/allocation moves to nimbus-network under NNC1.
Generalize to NetworkAttachmentId and inject from nimbus-network under NNC2.
Portable allocation moves; Netavark realization remains sandbox-owned.
Consume fenced super-net lease only; cluster transport remains outside nimbus-network.
Remain provider-adjacent effect state but conform to durable attachment fencing.
Move/generalize to nimbus-network under NNC1.3 without compatibility re-export.

trust_inputs_not_network_authorities.network_rule: Compute may compile only the already trusted/admitted tenant attribution; request path data never selects a network tenant.
Network never selects a verifier or inspects a bearer; failed silo authentication/admission makes zero network calls.
An in-memory generation lifetime for staged artifacts is not a PortLease and must remain a distinct type and authority.

non_production_exemptions.allowed_shape: loopback port zero or explicit collision fixture; never callable from a production target

non_production_exemptions.allowed_shape: loopback ephemeral fixture; never a product allocation authority
